terra.problem: Ezekiel's exile is not stated in this passage, and the explanation gives no reference for it.
The passage says Ezekiel is to take two sticks, not make them.
Papa guesses what Sparkle would have picked. He only remembers his cookie cutter kids; he does not speculate about them now.
The line about years away adds a length of time the passage does not give.
Egypt's place in Israel's past is a fact from outside the passage, but it has no reference.
It calls the baker's answer the wrong direction. Papa does not say 'wrong' about an answer.
The passage promises that the people will never again be divided into two kingdoms. It does not say the physical sticks stay joined.
The closing instruction, 'God sticks to what He says, and so should we,' sounds preachy in response to a missed answer.
Saying the baker has 'some Bible in you' assumes knowledge the answer choice does not establish.
The verse says the nations will know that the LORD sanctifies Israel. It does not say everybody around them will see it.
The claim about priests and the sanctuary comes from outside this passage and has no reference.
Calling Ezekiel a prophet and saying prophets hear a lot from God brings in facts from outside this passage without a reference.
